test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Attract** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Attract **means to draw or pull something or someone toward oneself; to evoke interest or admiration. (किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति को अपनी ओर खींचना या खींचना; रुचि या प्रशंसा जगाने के लिए) • **Example**: *The colourful display of flowers in the garden attracts butterflies and visitors alike.* • In this sentence, "attract" is used to convey the idea that the government is taking steps to draw in and encourage international investment in the renewable energy sector. • So, "**attract**" is the appropriate word to describe the government's efforts to pull in international investment and foster growth in the renewable energy sector through regulations, initiatives, and a welcoming atmosphere. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Conceive**: To form or develop an idea, plan, or concept in the mind. (मन में कोई विचार, योजना या अवधारणा बनाना या विकसित करना) • **Examine**: To inspect or scrutinize closely to understand, assess, or evaluate. (समझने, आँकने या मूल्यांकन करने के लिए बारीकी से निरीक्षण या जाँच करना) • **Borrow**: To take and use something with the intention of returning it or repaying it. (किसी चीज़ को वापस करने या चुकाने के इरादे से लेना और उपयोग करना) 160:T1582, आज राकेश ने अपनी दुकान का श्री **गणेश__** किया। अन्य विकल्प असंगत है।
